DE10-Lite interface board, four copper layers, 68.58 x 65.00 mm (JLCPCB stackup
JLC04161H-7628): USB 2.0 hub, VGA-to-HDMI conversion and HDMI capture, an RP2354B
microcontroller, a DAC and a DDS signal chain, a 9-28 V buck converter and an LDO tree.

Exported with kicad-cli 10.0.7 as IPC-2581 revision C, zip-compressed, millimetres; the
zone fill stored in the board file is used. The design files themselves are not included.
